name: UniSC Equity Bursary
summary: One-study-period bursary for full-time UniSC undergraduates from low income or disadvantaged backgrounds.
key: A$2,500 for one study period for applicants with the highest level of financial and/or personal hardship (A$1,000 for a high level).
who: Undergraduate from a low income and/or other disadvantaged background
Australian or New Zealand citizen, permanent humanitarian visa holder or permanent resident
catches: Apply 1 September to 30 November for Study Period 1 study, and 1 April to 31 May for Study Period 2
Preference goes to students without an undergraduate qualification

evidence.quote: A$2,500 for one study period for applicants who are assessed as having the highest level of financial and/or personal hardship considerations.
Students in an undergraduate degree from low income and/or other disadvantaged backgrounds.
Apply 1 September - 30 November for Study Period 1 study
